label: 2026-10 country expansion
method: Each new country's eight labour categories = its ANALOGUE country's 2026-09 categories × (published wage measure, new ÷ analogue, both from the SAME source and measure, both in £ at the 29 Sep 2026 FX snapshot). Energy = the country's published business / non-household tariff in £. Material, machine, overhead, packaging and logistics multipliers are the analogue's, held — an estimate, stated. Generated by scripts/region-expand.ts.

measures.eurostat-lc-2024: Eurostat, hourly labour costs, whole economy, 2024, € (news release 28 Mar 2025, ddn-20250328-1) — the latest year with every member state in one release (Belgium's 2025 estimate was not released)
measures.eurostat-lc-2025: Eurostat, hourly labour costs, whole economy, 2025, € (news release 31 Mar 2026, ddn-20260331-2)
measures.jetro-worker-2024: JETRO FY2024 Survey on Business Conditions of Japanese Companies Operating Overseas (Asia and Oceania), manufacturing worker monthly base salary, USD (survey Aug–Sep 2024, published Jan 2025)
measures.te-mfg-2026: Average monthly wages in manufacturing incl. bonuses, national statistics (MHLW, DGBAS, MOEL) as compiled by tradingeconomics.com: Japan and Taiwan the mean of the four 2026 quarters (JPY 383,417 / 681,338 / 371,834 / 368,935; TWD 56k / 59k / 63k / 66k); Korea the mean of the three published 2025 quarters (KRW 5,582,097 / 4,689,233 / 5,045,058) — Korea's 2026 quarters carry the record semiconductor special pay (MOEL H1 2026: special pay 601k won a month, the highest since 2011) and its Q4 figure was unreadable. Averaging whole years puts every bonus month in on both sides.
measures.avg-gross-2026: Average gross monthly earnings, all employees, national statistical office (RZS Serbia July 2026; INS Romania March 2026)
measures.min-wage-hourly-2026: Statutory minimum wage per hour, 2026, gross (Turkey TRY 33,030/month ÷ 225 h; Morocco SMIG 17.92 MAD/h; Tunisia SMIG 40-h regime 2.713 TND/h; Egypt private-sector EGP 7,000/month ÷ 208 h; South Africa NMW R30.23/h from 1 Mar 2026; Brazil R$1,621/month = R$7.37/h)
measures.mfg-hourly-2026: Average hourly earnings in manufacturing, local currency (Statistics Canada SEPH, hourly-paid employees, Jan 2026: CAD 32.47; BLS CES production and non-supervisory employees, Aug 2026: USD 30.37)

energySources.eurostat-nh-2025h2: Eurostat non-household electricity, 2nd half 2025, band 500–2,000 MWh/yr, € per 100 kWh (news release 8 May 2026, ddn-20260508-2); gas: Eurostat non-household gas 2nd half 2025 (ddn-20260508-3) — Bulgaria €4.14, Portugal and Belgium €4.81 per 100 kWh, others at the EU average €6.05
energySources.gpp-business: GlobalPetrolPrices.com, electricity prices for business, latest quarter published (Japan, Taiwan, Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia Q1 2026; others the site's latest), USD/kWh — a commercial tariff; a large plant on an industrial contract may pay less
energySources.tnb-2025: Tenaga Nasional Berhad tariff reform from 1 Jul 2025: average base tariff 45.40 sen/kWh (GlobalPetrolPrices' Malaysia business figure, $0.050, predates the reform)
energySources.taipower-industrial-2026: Taipower industrial average NT$4.27/kWh, unchanged at the September 2026 rate review (Taipei Times 18 Sep 2026; Focus Taiwan). Replaces the GlobalPetrolPrices business tariff ($0.213), which is not what a factory pays (country-rates review, Oct 2026)
energySources.meti-large-business-2026: GlobalPetrolPrices business price JPY 28.51/kWh (Dec 2025) ÷ 1.1119 — METI: small businesses pay 111.19% of the price large businesses pay — = JPY 25.64/kWh for a large industrial user
energySources.egypt-decree-1306-2026: Egypt Decree 1306/2026, from 1 May 2026: natural gas $6.75/MMBtu for general industrial activity ($7.75 iron & steel, $14 cement) — $6.75 ÷ 293.07 kWh/MMBtu = $0.02303/kWh
